description.value:
Adapted from the holodouble module. Once per day, as a standard action, the mech projects one holographic double of itself, as mirror image with one image. The mech spends 1 PP at the start of each of its turns to keep it. The double ends when the mech doesn't pay, when the double is struck, or when the mech ends it as a free action.

Auxiliary Slots: 1.
